ordered_stages.question: Does assigned transient trait-expression order change outcomes, distinct from spontaneous inherited order?

ordered_stages.question: Do selection-favoured responses survive diploid inheritance, demographic stochasticity and loss of variation?

ordered_stages.question: Does inherited evolution causally alter viable seed output, recruitment and unconditional persistence?

stop_rules: Do not select population size/ovule budget using outcome-exposed favourable cells.
No universal natural island threshold from synthetic N=6..9.
No natural genetic-order causality from assigned phenotype schedule.
No group-fitness conflict from negative focal maternal seed alone; include full W=.5F+.5P+S.
No long-run extinction claim from one-step pollen delivery, seed or Poisson-capped recruitment.
No external validation or public data DOI claim without completed source archive and independent evidence.
